title: 91% Works. 25% Is Secure.
caption:
I ship when the tests go green. That's the whole bug.

A new benchmark cut 450 tasks out of 150 real vulnerabilities and asked six agents to rebuild the missing code. The spec only described features, security never came up, same as every prompt I write. Best of the six was Claude Fable 5: 91.1% of tasks worked, 25.1% worked and were secure.

Across all 2,700 runs, 66% ended with code that runs and keeps the vulnerability. 56% of tasks were secured by none of the six. Only 12% of flaws got handled at every scope. Five of the six ran inside Claude Code, so it isn't the harness.

I don't read the diffs. I read the checkmark.

Who reviews your code?
